content.value: An inward flow turbine (reaction type with radial discharge) with an overall efficiency of 80% is required to develop 150 kW. The head is 8 m; peripheral velocity of the wheel is $0 . 9 6 { \sqrt { 2 g H } }$ the radial velocity of the flow is $0 . 3 6 \sqrt { 2 g H }$ . The wheel is to make 150 rpm, and the hydraulic losses in the turbine are 22% of the available energy. Determine –
(i) the angle of the guide blade at inlet,
(ii) the wheel vane angle at inlet,
(iv) the width of the wheel at inlet.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2024
